Record Class WebConsoleSnapshot.LatencyMetrics

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.sbk.webconsole.WebConsoleSnapshot.LatencyMetrics
Record Components:
average - average latency
minimum - minimum latency
maximum - maximum latency
invalid - invalid latency count
lowerDiscard - samples below the configured range
higherDiscard - samples above the configured range
slc1 - first SLC count
slc2 - second SLC count
percentileLabels - configured percentile labels
percentiles - corresponding percentile latency values
percentileCounts - corresponding percentile sample counts
Enclosing class:
WebConsoleSnapshot
